title: Deck the Halls
writers: Traditional Welsh tune 'Nos Galan'; English lyrics by Thomas Oliphant

evidence.note: The tune is the traditional Welsh carol 'Nos Galan' (melody published 1794), but the English words known today were written by Thomas Oliphant and first published in 1862 in volume 2 of 'Welsh Melodies'.

famous_use: Nat King Cole's recording reached #16 on the US Billboard Hot 100 and was certified gold in the UK and New Zealand.
